scope: Tenant deletion workflow control flow with activity doubles
checks: All four trigger sources suspend users, email and background activity before trigger-specific cancellation
Schedule and provider teardown precede tenant data deletion
Rollback reactivates users before email/background activity and does not delete data
Either resume failure is contained and rollback still completes
Provider teardown failure is contained before deletion
Legacy patch-disabled deletion and rollback omit new activity calls

validation.mutation: Removing background suspension produces four order-assertion failures, one per trigger source; source restored

limits: Temporal APIs and activities are doubled; this does not prove engine history replay compatibility or real provider side effects
Existing source-only contracts are not replaced or counted as executable behavior
